# CalDAV scheduling routes replies, server delivery and email fallback with caller limits

CalDavCalendar.addTargetCalendarItem:974–994 detects actual METHOD:REPLY and inbox
URI, starts processItipReply when explicit scheduling enabled, and returns.
It does not await that processing. processItipReply:2312–2354 fetches stored
item, resolves recurrence occurrence when relevant, clones it and replaces
matching attendees with received participationStatus. doModifyItem starts a
write with ignored ETag. Its listener only attempts inbox removal for status0,
using the older argument mismatch documented in [deletion](741c8be8-0056-4675-9e0c-9d195cfaa19f.md).
Missing stored item/occurrence is not guarded here. The async function's return
means initial fetch/setup finished, not successful remote modification/deletion.

canNotify:2360–2385 returns false for forceEmailScheduling; otherwise permits
REPLY/REQUEST/CANCEL/ADD only with automatic/explicit scheduling. senderAddress
uses override or first discovered address. sendItems:2403–2526 first routes
forced email through actual cal.provider.getImipTransport. With scheduling flags,
it emails only SCHEDULE-AGENT:CLIENT recipients and otherwise returns true without
delivery acknowledgement. For REPLY it considers organizer; otherwise attendees.
The scheduling capability route and explicit outbox code below it differ.

The later explicit-outbox branch strips RSVP through setAttendeeStatus for REPLY,
loops item list and constructs CalDavOutboxRequest. Its six arguments pass item
in the responseMethod position and omit the seventh item argument. Actual request
constructor:1037–1064 expects responseMethod,item, serializes the item and creates
METHOD from responseMethod. A controlled exact-body probe reached this call:
serializer received undefined item and METHOD received the item object. Real
serialization failure and reachability from all transport callers are unresolved;
do not describe every server-supported invitation as taking this branch.

After commit, provider checks recipient status prefixes, maps failed recipients
case-insensitively and falls back to email only for those recipients. Request
rejection logs. sendItems returns true before those asynchronous results.
OutboxResponse:1074–1097 expects response>recipient>href and request-status.
The unit fixture uses direct href rather than recipient wrapper; test824–848
checks outgoing METHOD/POST/headers and does not read response.data. Its existence
does not verify that response parser or fallback chain. test_itip_utils mock
calendar family is a possible caller link pending full caller/assertion reading;
no direct full provider scheduling assertion is claimed from its name.

## Evidence scope

Thunderbird `87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799`; Firefox `1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b`. All paths and ranges refer to these commits.
Use `git show REVISION:repository-relative-path` to read exact evidence.
Production privileged JavaScript, test bodies, fixtures and build files are
identified separately. Direct source observations do not establish runtime reachability
outside the checked callers. Inferred effects and unresolved branches are marked.
Test links describe assertions, not assumed passes. The run record gives the build limits.
Suite, immutable prior evidence and deliberate instructions were not changed.
